prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent isometric building sprite atlas for original Vietnamese city-building browser game Build City 26. Create ONE production-quality square PNG atlas, exactly THREE columns by THREE rows of NINE SEPARATE 3D-rendered building sprites. Equal square cells, invisible grid. Each sprite entirely inside its cell with at least 12% empty transparent padding on all sides; no shadow, tree, balcony or roof crossing a cell border. Read cells row-major left-to-right then top-to-bottom. Consistent orthographic isometric camera, azimuth 45 degrees and downward elevation 35 degrees, all buildings face the same bottom-left direction. Cohesive attractive economical stylized 3D, clean medium-low-poly geometry, softly bevelled edges, detailed enough for game but never photoreal. Contemporary Vietnamese architecture where relevant: cream/light pastel facades, terracotta or teal roofs, shaded verandas and tropical trees. Shared lighting from upper left, soft small contact shadows ONLY on own compact footprint. Every sprite has a low compact diamond-shaped footprint/plinth, flat street entrance facing lower left; do not include surrounding city, roads extending outside base, people, decorative vehicles, sky, background, floor plane, text, logos, labels, numbers, borders, watermarks or checkerboard drawn into pixels. Actual transparent alpha everywhere outside objects. Matte concrete, restrained turquoise accents, muted green trees, small warm detail. All nine objects visually distinct and easily identifiable, centers in precise equal 3x3 cells; uniform pictorial scale but taller towers can occupy more height within their own cell. Large sharp square output ideally 2048x2048 or larger. These are game sprites, NOT UI screenshots, NOT a connected city diorama. The nine objects in strict row-major order are: 1. compact two-story Vietnamese detached house, clay tile roof and garden; 2. three narrow Vietnamese townhouses with balconies, adjoining party walls; 3. six-story apartment block, cream facade and turquoise balconies; 4. five-story shophouse apartment building, storefront ground floor and apartments above; 5. simple economical eight-story apartment block, clean practical repetitive facade; 6. twenty-story residential tower on compact landscaped podium; 7. pair of modest six-story residential blocks and small shared courtyard; 8. Vietnamese single-story rural house, terracotta roof, small vegetable garden; 9. modern Vietnamese three-story villa, shaded terrace and pocket garden. Strong distinct architectural silhouettes. Avoid generic boxes: visibly pitched roofs, recessed windows, projecting balconies, shaded doors, stairs, roofline articulation and genuinely distinct building massing.

Left a slim collapsible builder panel about 280px wide titled 'Điện và nước', show exactly four clean rows with DISTINCT thumbnails: 'Trạm cấp nước', 'Tháp nước', 'Xử lý nước thải', 'Pin lưu trữ'; each row has small cost text and one small build icon; panel never sits in center of viewport. Right one compact inspector about 260px wide titled 'Trạm cấp nước', distinct pumping-station thumbnail, 'Công suất 5.000 m³/ngày', 'Điện: Đang cấp', 'Nhân viên: 6 / 6', 'Nâng cấp' mint button.
